selection.grouping: original report page filename; all turns and dialogues on each selected page retained
selection.selection_rule: SHA256(seed|group_id) ascending; include complete groups while <=100 turns; stop after 20 groups
selection.candidate_scope: Every provided table row and pre_text/post_text sentence in each question context; no gold-only selection
selection.case_order: original official dev_turn.json order within selected groups

encoder.provenance: Explicit local safetensors directory; local_files_only=True; trust_remote_code=False; token=False

resources.compute: CPU float32 model; float64 deterministic dot ranking
resources.peak_rss_scope: rescore process only; encoder_peak_rss_bytes separately records the actual model encoding process

controls.candidate_pool: all rows/sentences in provided original report excerpt; no gold filtering
controls.history: previous user questions only, no future questions or reference answers
controls.query_serialization: newline join of previous questions + current; no enumeration, labels or added numbers
controls.mrr_cutoff: 5 for top5 methods, 20 for candidate20; no unbounded MRR

limits: Public dev evidence retrieval; no claim of full-dialogue or end-to-end agent accuracy.
Report excerpt is supplied; source discovery is not evaluated.
Source rows/sentences vary in length; report context characters; not comparable directly to fixed-character E3.
100 related turns from 18 source-page groups, not 100 independent reports.
History questions do not replace the system's own prior answers for later reasoning.
